pending.heading: No agent has connected yet
pending.body: Install the Bayplan agent on a host to start managing {{name}}.
pending.bodyNoToken: Install the Bayplan agent on a host to start managing {{name}}. Ask an admin to finish setting it up.

reconnecting.heading: Reconnecting to {{name}}…
reconnecting.body: Bayplan just started and is waiting for the agent to reconnect. This usually takes under a minute.

offline.heading: {{name}} isn't reachable
offline.body: Bayplan lost contact with the agent on {{name}} at {{time}}.
offline.bodyNoTime: Bayplan lost contact with the agent on {{name}}.

revoked.heading: This environment was revoked
revoked.body: An admin revoked every agent on {{name}}, so Bayplan can't reach it.

clusterChanged.heading: This swarm was re-initialised
clusterChanged.body: The agents on {{name}} now report a different cluster, so Bayplan refused them. Nothing was changed on the old environment.
